class Probe {
public static bool Direct(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>{a.Add(3); return x-y;}); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2;}
public static bool NestedSort(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Resort(a,x,y)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2;}

public static bool Alias(){List<int> a=[2,1]; List<int> b=a; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(b,x,y,0)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && b.Count==2 && a[0]==2;}

public static bool NestedContainer(){List<List<int>> a=[[2,1]]; bool caught=false; try { a[0].Sort((x,y)=>ChangeFirst(a,x,y)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a[0].Count==2 && a[0][0]==2;}
public static bool Nullable(){List<int>? a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a!.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a!,x,y,0)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a!.Count==2 && a![0]==2;}

public static bool Growth(){List<int> a=[2,1]; a.Add(4); a.Add(3); bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,0)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==4 && a[0]==2 && a[2]==4;}
public static bool HelperSortTarget(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { SortAndMutate(a); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2;}
public static bool ReturnAlias(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(ReturnList(a),x,y,0)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2;}

public static bool CleanupAfterGuard(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,0)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } a.Add(0); a.Sort(); return caught && a.Count==3 && a[0]==0 && a[2]==2;}

public static bool CleanupAfterThrow(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>ThrowCompare(x,y)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } a.Add(0); a.Sort(); return caught && a.Count==3 && a[0]==0;}
public static bool UnrelatedMutation(){List<int> a=[2,1]; List<int> b=[9]; a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(b,x,y,0)); return a[0]==1 && a.Count==2 && b.Count==2;}
public static bool UnrelatedSort(){List<int> a=[2,1]; List<int> b=[4,3]; a.Sort((x,y)=>Resort(b,x,y)); return a[0]==1 && b[0]==3;}

public static bool NestedFailureCleanup(){List<int> a=[2,1]; List<int> b=[4,3]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>SortOtherAndMutate(b,a,x,y)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } a.Add(0); b.Add(0); a.Sort(); b.Sort(); return caught && a.Count==3 && b.Count==3 && a[0]==0 && b[0]==0;}

public static bool StoredHelper(){Holder h=new Holder(); bool caught=false; try { h.Items.Sort((x,y)=>Change(h.Items,x,y,0)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && h.Items.Count==2 && h.Items[0]==2;}

public static bool StoredNestedSort(){Holder h=new Holder(); bool caught=false; try { h.Items.Sort((x,y)=>Resort(h.Items,x,y)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && h.Items.Count==2 && h.Items[0]==2;}
public static bool HelperAdd(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,0)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2 && a[1]==1;}
public static bool HelperInsert(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,1)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2 && a[1]==1;}
public static bool HelperRemove(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,2)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2 && a[1]==1;}

public static bool HelperRemoveAt(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,3)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2 && a[1]==1;}
public static bool HelperClear(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,4)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2 && a[1]==1;}

public static bool HelperIndexWrite(){List<int> a=[2,1]; bool caught=false; try { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,5)); } catch(NeoError e) { caught=true; } return caught && a.Count==2 && a[0]==2 && a[1]==1;}

public static int Change(List<int> a,int x,int y,int mode) { if(mode==0) { a.Add(3); } else if(mode==1) { a.Insert(0,3); } else if(mode==2) { a.Remove(2); } else if(mode==3) { a.RemoveAt(0); } else if(mode==4) { a.Clear(); } else { a[0]=3; } return x-y; }
public static int ChangeFirst(List<List<int>> a,int x,int y) { return Change(a[0],x,y,0); }
public static int Resort(List<int> a,int x,int y) { a.Sort(); return x-y; }
public static void SortAndMutate(List<int> a) { a.Sort((x,y)=>Change(a,x,y,0)); }
public static List<int> ReturnList(List<int> a) { return a; }
public static int ThrowCompare(int x,int y) { throw new NeoArgumentError("comparison failed"); }
public static int SortOtherAndMutate(List<int> b,List<int> a,int x,int y) { b.Sort((u,v)=>Change(a,u,v,0)); return x-y; }
